stem: Which source should control a Philippine-specific legal or regulatory statement in a Komadrona lesson?

choices.text: An anonymous reviewer note shared in a group chat
The current official law, regulation, or issuing-body publication
A popular short-form video without source links

rationale: Philippine-specific legal and regulatory claims must be checked against the current official text or issuing-body publication. Secondary explanations can help with learning but cannot silently replace the controlling source.

distractorRationales.rationale: Anonymous notes cannot establish authority, version, or accountability.
AI output can assist drafting but is not a final authority and may omit or distort controlling details.
Popularity does not establish accuracy, currency, or official status.
